      1. System users or group tags added in the "Employee/Group Error Notifications" field of the collection channel should receive notifications if the payment package associated with this collection channel has an error protocol.

      2. System should automatically send notification to creation user via System and via Email

      3. Hardcode text:

        1. English: Payment package ID: 21 either has no associated liability or does not fully cover the liability.

        1. Bulgarian: ÐÐ»Ð°ÑÐ°Ð½Ðµ Ñ ID: 21 Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð½ÑÐ¼Ð° ÑÐ²ÑÑÐ·Ð°Ð½Ð¾ Ð·Ð°Ð´ÑÐ»Ð¶ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ, Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð½Ðµ Ð¿Ð¾ÐºÑÐ¸Ð²Ð° Ð·Ð°Ð´ÑÐ»Ð¶ÐµÐ½Ð¸ÐµÑÐ¾ Ð¸Ð·ÑÑÐ»Ð¾.

    3. Manage Notifications (https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PHX-10619 )

      1. in system notification should have notification bell icon on top right corner

      2. Bell icon should have number of unread notification with red color on top right corner

      3. After clicking icon should see all read and unread notification, ordered by first unread and then read. and then creation date & time descending

      4. Upon clicking a notification message, the system should open a new tab displaying the page object created by that notification. After clicking on the notification and opening the new tab, the notification's status should change to "read."

        1. If the notification is unread, the mail icon should appear open.

        2. If the notification is read, the mail icon should appear closed.

      5. The system user should receive a notification within one minute after the notification is created.

      6. Modal window which opens after clicking on bell icon should have scroll and by default should display only 10 notification, and when user scroll down should load next 10. like pagination on scroll

      7. Notification text should be displayed in the language used by the system user.

      8. Limit the text to a maximum of 3 lines. If the content exceeds this limit, display an ellipsis (…) at the end of the third line, with the full text visible on hover.

      9. Read notification should disappear after 5 days from list.

      10. Read notifications should be cleared from DB after 1 month.

      11. Unread notifications should be cleared from DB after 3 month.

      12. List of Objects That Generate Notifications,One of these objects will be included in the notification message. When the notification is clicked, the corresponding object should open.

        1. Process: All types

        2. Billing Run: All types

        3. Payment Package

        4. Task
